name: meet-champion
description: Meet Champion — Portable monorepo. Fans book paid 1:1 video calls with verified Champions.

scripts.dev: echo 'Run npm run mobile in one shell and npm run admin in another'
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @meet-champion/mobile run lint && npm --workspace @meet-champion/admin run lint
scripts.test: npm --workspace @meet-champion/mobile run test --if-present && npm --workspace @meet-champion/admin run test --if-present && npm --workspace @meet-champion/shared run test --if-present
scripts.supabase:seed: supabase db reset --linked=false && supabase db push
